purpose: Every future NanoJev candidate must report two separate benchmark tracks: a pinned public benchmark for external interpretability and an independently authored deep benchmark for internal capability, calibration, OOD, and protected-error diagnosis. The two tracks are reported side by side and are never averaged into an unstated composite.

public_benchmark.name: JevBench public milestone
public_benchmark.role: external comparability; public diagnostic evidence now, official milestone evidence later
public_benchmark.public_diagnostic_rule: pinned public rows may be run on unfrozen candidates when needed; each diagnostic run is logged and is not promotion evidence
public_benchmark.one_shot_rule: one official milestone run per frozen candidate; no retries, no threshold tuning, no prompt changes, no per-item failure-driven repair
public_benchmark.quarantine: public task rows, outcomes, and external outputs are evaluation-only and are never used for training, calibration fitting, or per-item tuning

custom_deep_benchmark.name: NanoJev engineering deep benchmark
custom_deep_benchmark.role: internal capability, calibration, OOD, cardinality-shift, and protected-error diagnosis
custom_deep_benchmark.read_rule: one local read per completed candidate only after checkpoint hash and CUDA-to-MPS owned parity pass
custom_deep_benchmark.quarantine: heldout items may diagnose aggregate failure families but must never be copied, paraphrased, or used as direct training labels
